title: cnidoscolus tenuifolius
intro: Cnidoscolus tenuifolius, commonly known as the "cascabel" or "manzanillo," is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family, characterized by its edible and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Cnidoscolus tenuifolius include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate symptoms of arthritis, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and analgesic effects, making it useful for pain relief and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Cnidoscolus tenuifolius include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
